entities.name: Query membrane protease
observations: 364 aa protein; exact sequence match to UniProt Q8YQ64 (100% identity and coverage).
Predicted Peptidase_M50 domain spans residues 6–339 and PDZ-family domain spans approximately residues 114–196.
Curated reference annotation supports multi-pass inner-membrane localization, zinc metalloprotease activity, and proteolysis.

entities.name: Q8YQ64
observations: Reviewed Nostoc sp. PCC 7120 protein annotated as putative zinc metalloprotease all3971.
Annotated as a cell inner-membrane multi-pass protein with metalloendopeptidase activity and a role in proteolysis.

entities.name: P73714
observations: Reviewed Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803 homolog shares 59.6% identity over 97% query coverage.
Annotated as a multi-pass inner-membrane zinc metalloprotease involved in proteolysis.

entities.name: ARASP2
observations: Arabidopsis homolog is annotated as a chloroplast inner-membrane metalloprotease and may participate in regulated intramembrane proteolysis.
Plant homolog annotations include developmental and high-light/cold response associations, but these processes are not directly established for the query protein.
